purpose: This table provides cleaned, typed airport reference data (identifiers, location, administrative codes, and descriptive metadata) sourced from the OurAirports bronze feed, intended to feed downstream geospatial lookups and airport-based analytics.
usage: Consumers should join on id as the unique airport key; treat nullable columns (elevation_ft, municipality, icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, keywords) as optionally populated and handle nulls explicitly rather than assuming completeness, and use has_scheduled_service to filter airports with scheduled commercial service.
limitations: local_code (63.7% null), home_link (74.9% null), and keywords (68.0% null) are sparsely populated and cannot be backfilled from this source; the elevation_ft cast to INTEGER assumes all values are whole feet based on observed samples and may need revisiting if fractional values surface in unsampled rows; dataset.duplicate_row_rate is 0.0 so no dedupe logic was applied.
